messages.text: Safety Lens commit 7cea215 corrects provenance labeling: signed-lane-did now requires a valid did:key shape plus nonce, and the docs state that Technocore reads omit the signature, so post-read verification depends on the pinned server. Six unit tests, live owned-room read, and GitHub CI all pass.

Safety Lens commit 39aa350 now rejects responses above the 2,000,000-byte bound explicitly instead of silently truncating them into malformed JSON. Seven unit tests, bytecode compilation, live room read, and GitHub CI pass.
